wwo.name: Kyoto
wwo.method: Selected nineteenth-century survey geometry joins Shijo Karasuma and Nishiki to the Kamo crossing, Gion street frontages, the Yasaka approach and the early Maruyama park at the Higashiyama foothills. The Nishijin and Toji/south rail review locations remain outside the candidate. Partial street coverage uses fallback outside indicated mapped areas.

registration.reference: Affine registration against four matched tiles of a georeferenced copy of the same 1892 edition. Intermediate pixels are Web Mercator z16. GeoJSON is CRS84.
registration.precision_limit: Fit residual applies only within the overlap. The central and western parts of the corridor use affine extrapolation. The fit is to another copy of the map. Positional and apparent construction dimensions are approximate.

sources.title: Kyoto 15, Imperial Army Land Survey Department, 1:20,000
sources.publisher: International Research Center for Japanese Studies, map 002469278
sources.licence: Historical public-domain map. Attribution to International Research Center for Japanese Studies. Only original geometry transcription is distributed.
sources.precision: Transcribed centres of visible streets, selected roof or block footprints, river and canal features and mapped landscape openings.
